items.title: Why Is Citigroup (C) Building A Bigger China Business Through A New Securities Unit?
items.summary: Citigroup (NYSE:C) has received regulatory approval to establish a wholly owned securities company in China, Citigroup Securities (China) Company Limited. The new unit is set to offer equities brokerage, securities underwriting, and research services to onshore and international clients. This approval expands Citigroup's onshore footprint in China's capital markets through a dedicated securities entity. items.title: Citi upgrades Ferrovial as I-24 payment structure eases cash concerns

items.title: Change in Congress Could Bring Wall Street a Headache
items.summary: Bank lobbyists have won watered-down capital requirements, a friendlier annual stress-testing framework, scaled-back consumer-protection enforcement, and reduced small-bank supervision while Republicans control Congress and Trump-appointed officials lead financial regulators.
